infoLinks.content:
From 12:01am until 11pm on Sunday 19 October, route 263 services will be starting and ending trips at different stops in Crows Nest due to road closures for the Crows Nest Fest event.
 
Stops on Willoughby Rd and Burlington St will be missed.
 
Buses to the city will start trips from Ernest St at West St Crows Nest (Stop ID 2065104).
Buses from the city to Crows Nest will end trips at Ernest St at West St Crows Nest (Stop ID 2065106).
 
Continue on foot via Ernest St to access Willoughby Rd. Allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. See the event page for more information.
 
Closed stops
  • Willoughby Rd after Holtermann St (Stop ID 206538)
  • Crows Nest, Burlington St, Stand D (Stop ID 206540)
